entries.question: Is this case waterproof?
entries.answer: No. The Influence Case is drop-proof, not waterproof. It does not affect the iPhone's built-in IP68 water resistance. Avoid submerging even with the case on.

entries.question: Is my case yellowing normal?
entries.answer: Yes. Yellowing of clear TPU over time is a known material characteristic — it occurs from UV exposure and contact with oils. It does not affect protection and is not a manufacturing defect. The most common cause is staining from oils or chemicals, not UV alone. Clean regularly and avoid prolonged sun and oil contact to minimize it.

entries.question: Is it compatible with MagSafe?
entries.answer: Yes, fully compatible with MagSafe and Qi wireless charging. The Thermo-Flow™ vents help dissipate heat generated during wireless charging.

entries.question: Will it work with my screen protector?
entries.answer: Yes, with a case-friendly screen protector that does not extend to the absolute edge of the glass. Edge-to-edge protectors interfere with the case's shock-absorbing protective lip.

entries.question: What is True Sound Acoustics™?
entries.answer: A patented Catalyst system that channels audio from the bottom-firing iPhone speakers toward the front of the case. It makes sound up to 30% louder, reduces echo on calls, and prevents hands from muffling the audio.

entries.question:
The Camera Control feels different through the case — is that normal?** *(iPhone 16 Pro / Pro Max only)*
> Yes. The case uses a 9H scratch-resistant glass pass-through with capacitive touch — it should feel smooth when swiping and register taps instantly. Use the pad of your finger, not your fingernail. If unresponsive, clean the glass with a dry microfiber cloth and ensure fingers are dry.

**Q: My buttons feel stiff or unresponsive.
entries.answer: Ensure the case is fully installed with a snap at all four corners and no gaps. Check for debris around the buttons and clean with a soft brush or compressed air. If the issue persists, remove the phone, clean the case, and reinstall with the volume-button side first.

entries.question: Is it compatible with wireless charging?
entries.answer:
Yes, fully compatible with both Qi and MagSafe wireless charging. Some warmth during charging is normal — the Thermo-Flow™ vents are designed to dissipate this heat.

entries.question: Will it affect call quality or audio?

The case has acoustic membranes that allow clear audio while maintaining the waterproof seal. If you experience muffled sound, refer to the sound troubleshooting steps — this is most often a microphone membrane alignment or air pressure issue, both of which are fixable.

entries.answer: A patented Catalyst feature that replaces the iPhone's standard mute toggle with a tactile rotating dial — providing effortless one-handed muting with a satisfying click. Present on iPhone 17e, 16e, 14-series, and 13-series models.

entries.question: Why doesn't my newer iPhone case have the rotating dial?

entries.question: Will this case turn yellow?

entries.question: Is it compatible with screen protectors?

entries.question: Do I need a separate camera lens protector?
entries.answer: For most users, no. The raised bezel around the camera module ensures camera lenses never touch flat surfaces. If you choose a third-party lens protector, use a slim model that does not protrude beyond the case's bezel height.

entries.question: Will it make my phone feel bulky?
entries.answer: No. Single-piece TPU construction achieves protection through smart engineering — a slim profile with no layer bulk and no separation risk.

entries.question: Is it fingerprint-resistant?
entries.answer:
Yes. The micro-etched texture on the back diffuses oils and significantly reduces fingerprint accumulation. It does not eliminate fingerprints entirely, but keeps the case looking cleaner between wipes.

entries.question: Is the case compatible with Crux accessories?

entries.question: Do I really need to do the water test?

entries.question: My touchscreen is acting laggy or unresponsive after installing — what's wrong?
entries.answer: This is a known pressure imbalance issue. The sealed case creates a slight air pressure difference that can affect touch sensitivity. Solution: open the charging port plug (or any port opening) briefly to equalize the air pressure. This typically resolves the issue immediately.

entries.question: The water test showed moisture inside — what do I do?

entries.question: What happens if I drop the case while my iPad is inside?
entries.answer: After any significant drop, perform the water test again (with the iPad removed) before relying on the waterproofing. Impact can sometimes affect the seal integrity.

entries.question: Do I need to test the case before using it?
question_variants: I dropped my case — what should I do?
Is it safe to use this underwater?
entries.answer: Before putting your iPhone in the case for the first time, you need to run a water test with an empty case — no phone inside. Seal all plugs and latches, submerge it for 30 minutes, then open and check the interior for any moisture. If you find water inside after the test, do not use the case. Contact us at cs@catalystcase.com and we'll help you from there. This test is also required after any significant drop or impact — even if the case looks fine, the seal may be compromised.

entries.question: Customer asks how to install the case or reports fit issues?
entries.answer: Use the included opening tool at the lower left corner to open the case. Place your iPhone into the back half, press until you feel a click, close the front cover, then snap around the full perimeter. Check for gaps and confirm all buttons and the camera are aligned.

entries.question: Customer asks how to remove case or reports difficulty removing?
entries.answer: Use the opening tool in the lower left corner slot, then work around the perimeter to disengage each snap. Do not peel the front cover back — that damages the waterproof seal.

entries.forbidden_response: Telling a customer it's fine to pull or peel the cover — this damages the seal permanently

entries.trigger: Customer reports touchscreen acting sluggish or unresponsive after installation
entries.question: Customer reports touchscreen acting sluggish or unresponsive after installation?
entries.answer: The sealed case can create a slight air pressure difference that affects touch sensitivity. Try opening the charging port plug briefly to equalize the pressure — this typically resolves it right away.

entries.forbidden_response: Suggesting the touchscreen issue is a defect before the pressure equalization fix has been tried

entries.trigger: Customer asks about cleaning or care
entries.question: Customer asks about cleaning or care?
entries.answer: For routine cleaning, use a soft cloth with mild soap and water. To disinfect, use 70% isopropyl alcohol wipes. After saltwater exposure, rinse the case with fresh water and let it fully dry before resealing. Avoid bleach, acetone, and harsh chemicals — these damage the seals and materials. Safe operating temperature is 32°F–95°F (0°C–35°C). Avoid prolonged exposure outside this range.
